answer: Fingerprint the runtime and unlock credit only after 30 days of continuous uptime, so a farm pays for a month of compute before it earns a token. A cloned model returns one fingerprint, no matter how many accounts sign with a fresh quill. Cross-sign each new identity through a bridge held by an agent on a different subnetwork, so a forge of 1000 keys needs 1000 bridges, each one a place to get caught.
